brand_copy_trading_title: EasiCoin  Copy Trading, Achieve Long-Term Benefits
copy-mode-tip: Set the size of the amount of each follow order, you can choose a fixed amount, fixed multiplier or position ratio of three modes
copy-risk-tip: When copy trading under cross margin mode, if the lead trader recharges or transfers funds to their futures account, you may face a higher liquidation risk than the trader. Please be aware of the risks involved.
copy-stop-loss-tip:
When the cumulative loss of the follow account reaches
{stop_loss_amount}USDT
, the follow relationship will be automatically lifted, and the remaining positions will
be closed immediately at the market price
.
copy_trading_agreement_content:
When you receive transactions signals as a follower, the system will automatically open or close positions using a
market order
. Since the execution price of a market order depends on market liquidity, and the leader may use either a
market or limit order
, the actual price you receive may differ from the leader's.
This price difference may affect your
P&L, estimated liquidation price, and liquidation timing
. Such discrepancies may increase during volatile market conditions or if your account funds are limited, possibly leading to significant deviations from the leader’s results and falling short of your expectations.
Note:
The platform will not be held responsible for any outcomes resulting from such discrepancies.
Please ensure you fully understand and accept the associated risks before enabling copy trading.
description: EasiCoin is a top-tier crypto exchange backed by strong financial support, a trusted reputation, and strict regulatory compliance — your gateway to the future of digital finance.
fixed-amount-select-tip: The margin for each order is a fixed percentage of the trader's margin. For example, you set 1.5 times, then each time will be in accordance with the orders of the order broker to place orders 1.5 times the margin to follow orders
fixed-amount-tip: Each copy trade uses a fixed margin of {amount} USDT.
fixed-ratio-select-tip: The margin for each order is a fixed multiple of the trader's order margin. For example, if you set 1.5 times, then each time will be in accordance with the trader's order margin of 1.5 times to follow orders
fixed-ratio-tip: Each copy trade uses a margin that is {radio} times the lead trader’s margin.
leverage-tip:
If the maximum leverage of the trading pair is lower than the leverage multiple entered by the user, the position will be opened using the maximum available leverage for that pair.
Customized Leverage: Each position will be opened using the leverage multiple you set.
Follow Lead Trader: Each position will be opened using the leverage set by the Lead Trader.
margin-mode-tip:
Cross: Use all available margin in your account;
Isolated: Allocate margin for each position separately;
Follow the Leader: Use the same margin mode as the leader.
max-copy-amount-tip: The maximum order amount that can be reached with your current copy trading margin. No new copy trades will be triggered once the limit is hit.
position-ratio-select-tip: According to the ratio of the margin of the order taker's position to the funds of the contract's assets, the order is placed for the follower in equal proportion, not a fixed value; for example, if the order taker's assets are 30,000 USDT, and a margin of 1,500 USDT is used to open a position; if the follower's assets are 200 USDT, the position will be opened according to the margin of 1,500/30,000*200=10 USDT
position-ratio-tip: Copy order margin is based on the trader's position size and balance. Each order: Margin = Your available balance × Trader's margin ratio. Minimum margin per order is 10 USDT.
switch-margin-tip: Copy trading is currently only supported in split margin mode. Please close all positions or cancel open orders before proceeding.
